d: A young voter puts Bernie Sanders and Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed on the spot with a question about how they would pay for Medicare for All and free college. Sanders calls for a 5% annual wealth tax on billionaires, arguing that taxing extreme wealth could raise more than $4 trillion over 10 years to fund healthcare, affordable housing, universal childcare and tuition-free public colleges. El-Sayed backs the proposal, explaining how wealth generates more wealth while ordinary workers struggle to build financial security.
